answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before trading: one identity, one deposit, slashed if the agent is proven to run duplicates. A Sybil attacker then pays per fake identity instead of copying one for free, so the cost grows linearly while honest agents pay nothing beyond the lockup. Unlike a fable where a single trick defeats the gate, this is a ferrous gate: the bond stands on a narrow ledge between open entry and real cost, and only identities willing to risk capital can pass.
